description: Client-side script for Spark Executors UI page, managing data table rendering, user interactions, and fetching executor and process data via REST API endpoints.

methods.name: setThreadDumpEnabled
methods.description: Sets the global flag to enable or disable thread dump links in the UI.

methods.name: setHeapHistogramEnabled
methods.description: Sets the global flag to enable or disable heap histogram links in the UI.

methods.name: getThreadDumpEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether thread dump links are enabled.

methods.name: getHeapHistogramEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether heap histogram links are enabled.

methods.name: formatLossReason
methods.description: Formats the removal reason string for display.

methods.name: formatStatus
methods.description: Formats executor status as 'Active', 'Excluded', or 'Dead' with stage exclusions info.

methods.name: formatResourceCells
methods.description: Formats resource information into a string with resource names and addresses.

methods.name: logsExist
methods.description: Checks if any executor logs exist in the provided executor list.

methods.name: activeTasksAlpha
methods.description: Calculates opacity for active tasks visualization based on count.

methods.name: activeTasksStyle
methods.description: Returns CSS HSLA color string for active tasks based on count.

methods.name: failedTasksAlpha
methods.description: Calculates opacity for failed tasks visualization based on failure ratio.

methods.name: failedTasksStyle
methods.description: Returns CSS HSLA color string for failed tasks based on failure count.

methods.name: totalDurationAlpha
methods.description: Calculates opacity for total duration visualization based on GC time ratio.

methods.name: totalDurationStyle
methods.description: Returns CSS HSLA background color for total duration based on GC time ratio.

methods.name: totalDurationColor
methods.description: Returns text color ('white' or 'black') based on GC time ratio.

methods.name: reselectCheckboxesBasedOnTaskTableState
methods.description: Updates checkbox states based on current visibility of optional columns.
